_about: REALM: The Card Game, first ritual set. Draft for review: costs and numbers will be tuned in play. Elements beat the next one round the circle: light > dark > spirit > magic > knowledge > light (x1.5 damage; x0.75 the other way). A champion's HP is 40% of its five stats added up; it attacks with one of its stats, dealing a quarter of that stat.

rituals.name: Supernova
rituals.text: Deal 30 Light damage to an enemy champion.

rituals.name: Rays of Dawn
rituals.text: Your champion's Light +15 until your next turn.

rituals.name: Solar Flare
rituals.text: Deal 20 Light damage to every enemy champion.

rituals.name: Halo
rituals.text: Heal one of your champions for 25.

rituals.name: Eclipse
rituals.text: Swap a champion's Light and Dark.

rituals.name: Call of the Abyss
rituals.text: Deal 40 Dark damage to an enemy champion. Your active champion loses 10 HP.

rituals.name: Blood Moon
rituals.text: An enemy champion loses 20 HP. Your active champion heals 20.

rituals.name: Ossuary Shroud
rituals.text: Your active champion cannot be targeted until your next turn.

rituals.name: Lightning Strike
rituals.text: Deal 25 Magic damage to an enemy champion.

rituals.name: Lightning Storm
rituals.text: Deal 15 Magic damage to every enemy champion.

rituals.name: Mushroom Ring
rituals.text: Heal all your champions for 15.

rituals.name: Moon Dust
rituals.text: Heal a champion for 10 and draw a card.

rituals.name: Warm Aura
rituals.text: Your champion's next attack deals 50% more.

rituals.name: Verdant Growth
rituals.text: A champion gains 30 max HP and heals 30.

rituals.name: Ancestral Trees
rituals.text: Give a champion a 30 HP shield.

rituals.name: Mandala Ward
rituals.text: Your active champion blocks the next attack completely.

rituals.name: Planetary Alignment
rituals.text: All your champions' stats +10 until your next turn.

rituals.name: UFO Abduction
rituals.text: An enemy champion's highest stat is cut by 25 for the rest of the match.

rituals.name: Sacred Geometry
rituals.text: Draw two cards.

rituals.name: Third Eye
rituals.text: See the rival's hand. Draw a card.

rituals.name: Essence Surge
rituals.text: Gain 2 Essence this turn.
